headline: Choosing the Right Paint Finish for Your East Bay Addition: A Comparison
articleBody:
Deciding on the perfect paint finish for your new addition in the East Bay can feel overwhelming with all the options out there. It's not just about color; the sheen and coating type make a big difference in appearance, durability, and how easy it is to clean. For instance, flat or matte finishes hide imperfections well and offer a sophisticated look, but they're generally less durable and harder to clean. On the other hand, semi-gloss or high-gloss paints are super durable and easy to wipe down, making them great for high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms, though they'll show every little imperfection. Eggshell and satin finishes strike a nice balance, offering a subtle sheen with good durability. You'll want to think about how much wear and tear the room will get and what kind of aesthetic you're aiming for.
